plan.topic: More hair in the brush on orforglipron (Foundayo)? Hair loss is listed on the US label
plan.angle:
08:00 calm 'Is this normal?' visible body moment, and a spin-off of L1 that asks one fresh question (hair) without re-cutting the L1 script.
- Sentence 1 (14 words or fewer) names orforglipron (Foundayo), and the relief fact goes in the same sentence: hair loss is a listed side effect on the US label. Give the label's per-arm rate vs placebo only if the label prints it (Foundayo PI rev 7/2026), matching L1's verified s21 numbers exactly. Otherwise use the label's wording only.
- One line: shedding linked to weight loss is often temporary (credited to AAD or DermNet). Don't claim the drug is the cause.
- Untagged: enough protein, unless your clinician limits it. See a doctor if shedding is patchy, painful or lasts more than about 6 months.
- Closing: the scoped don't-stop line, 'Not personal advice, so ask your prescriber.', then the loop line. No subscribe line, no link line, 160 words or fewer.
- Post note (Exp G): the target is the Foundayo long video (LWyUfli67CI), switching to the new Foundayo video once it's live.

package.title: Orforglipron (Foundayo): More Hair in Your Brush? #shorts
package.description:
Orforglipron (Foundayo) lists hair loss on its US label, and the label links it to weight loss. Hair usually regains its normal fullness within 6–9 months. See a doctor if shedding is patchy, painful, or lasts more than about 6 months. #Orforglipron
Don't stop or change your medicine on your own.
Not personal advice. Talk to your doctor or prescriber about whether it's right for you.

factcheck.summary:
The facts in this Short are correct, so it can ship once you make the minor fixes below.

**What I checked:**
- **Foundayo label (rev 7/2026):** it lists hair loss among the most common adverse reactions (≥5%) and in the Medication Guide's list of common side effects. It also says hair loss was "associated with weight reduction". So s01 is accurate.
- **AAD shedding page:** it lists losing 20 pounds or more as a trigger. It says "As your body readjusts, the excessive shedding stops" and "Within six to nine months, the hair tends to regains its normal fullness." That supports s02 and s03.
- **Word count:** I counted 116 spoken words myself, which fits the tight arm (90–120).
- **Safety:** the protein tip has the "unless your clinician limits it" caveat. The don't-stop line and "Not personal advice, so ask your prescriber." are present, and the safety line is on one card. There's no subscribe or link line, and no dosing advice.

**What needs fixing:**
- **s02:** the link between the drug and weight-loss shedding is implied but never stated. Add the label's own sentence.
- **s06:** the on-screen text shortens the spoken safety line. It has to show the full line.
- **s05:** the card doesn't show the warning signs, so a muted viewer gets nothing from it.
- **s03:** the stat label says "regrowth", but the AAD measure is "normal fullness".
- **src2:** I couldn't find the year "2024" on the AAD page.
- **s05:** the "more than about six months" cutoff isn't sourced and sits close to the 6–9-month timeline.

**Not checked:** I didn't verify the watch-next video ID LWyUfli67CI. The publisher should confirm it's live.

issues.claim: Dermatologists say shedding after a big weight loss usually stops as the body readjusts.
issues.problem: Applying the AAD's general weight-loss (telogen effluvium) timeline to Foundayo relies on an unstated step. The label says Foundayo hair loss was 'associated with weight reduction', but it doesn't say the hair loss resolves. Saying that step out loud keeps the framing honest and anchors the dermatologist claim to the source.
issues.fix: Narration: "Here's the reassuring part. The label links it to weight loss, and dermatologists say shedding after a big weight loss usually stops as the body readjusts." (+8 words, total 124: to stay in the tight arm, trim s06 to "Don't stop or change your medicine on your own." plus "Full video on our channel." and s04 to "Two tips. Get enough protein, unless your clinician limits it.") On-screen: "Linked to weight loss; usually stops"

issues.problem: House rule: fixed safety lines are spoken and shown exactly. The card drops 'or change your medicine'.
issues.fix: on_screen_text: "DON'T STOP OR CHANGE YOUR MEDICINE ON YOUR OWN."

issues.problem: Fails the muted-viewer test: the card never shows the signs (patchy, painful, more than about 6 months).
issues.fix: on_screen_text: "Patchy, painful or 6+ months? See a doctor."

issues.claim: See a doctor if shedding is patchy, painful, or lasts more than about six months.
issues.problem: This is our own safety line, so it needs no source tag. But the 'six months' cutoff sits right next to the AAD's 6–9-month fullness timeline in s03, which could confuse viewers. The AAD wording itself is gentler: see a dermatologist if you're concerned.
issues.fix: Keep as is, or use: "See a doctor if shedding is patchy, painful, lasts more than about six months, or worries you." (+3 words; keep the total at 120 or fewer)

issues.problem: The AAD measure is hair regaining 'normal fullness', not 'regrowth'. Keep the source's exact measure.
issues.fix: stat_label: "Hair usually back to normal fullness after weight-loss shedding (AAD)"

issues.problem: I found no date on the AAD page, and house rules ban bare or unverified years.
issues.fix: Replace with the page's 'Last updated' date if one appears in the page footer. Otherwise use "n.d. (accessed 2026-11-23)".
